scope: Agent visual/scenario review of actual candidate screenshots. Not a human study or final accessibility qualification.
findings: Actions stays visible at the actual 500x420 minimum in Light and Dark; command labels and muted unavailable states remain readable.
The reviewed name-conflict dialog has distinct Keep both/Skip/Cancel and explicit red Replace; USB Replace is disabled.
Actual transfer feedback names the phase, source and destination with bounded progress and Cancel. The minimized owner keeps global feedback above the taskbar.
Stopped operations keep an accessible Details route and do not display the incomplete target as a completed file.
Actual 1920x1200/150% and 3840x2160/200% show crisp native typography, original icons and non-overlapping essential action controls.

carry_forward.observation: The existing shared-menu helper footer uses bounded ellipsis. Conflict text lists general replacement limits rather than the selected USB provider reason and does not enumerate matching source/target paths; refine those feedback details in the planned feedback stage.
Preserve the earlier drawn-cursor-versus-hit HiDPI observation for isolation; scripted actions alone do not establish human pointer usability.
